dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: How does it feel to be back? Frederica's not around, sure, but the Knights' HQ is still a familiar sight, right?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Yes, and we have some new faces, too. May the Anemo Archon watch over them.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hey now, don't look at me. She's out on a secret mission, as you know full well. Can't tell you about it, no sir.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: In any case, you'd have better luck asking Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: C'mon... I know Acting Grand Master's a rough gig. I mean, I'm back, aren't I? I'll help her out for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: ...Oh, for Barbatos's sake. Would it kill you to sit in that office yourself, Varka?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Jean's exhausted. She needs rest — and by that, I mean people need to force her to take some.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Just look at her! You'd think she was the only person in Mondstadt without the right to drink and sleep!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: The "duty" to drink and sleep, I think you mean! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Thank you for the corrections, Grand Master. Why, if I hadn't been appointed Cardinal, I'd—

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, relax. You're acting like your old adventurer self again. Y'know, like how you were back when you and Frederica came to Mondstadt together.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Years and years spent in the Church of Favonius on her account hasn't changed your temper much, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: I joined the Church because of the Anemo Archon's guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Sure, sure. You're the Cardinal here, not me.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: ...Barbatos give me strength...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Alright, don't worry, I'll figure something out, okay? I've already asked Hertha to put out a call for recruits.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: And that kid Lohen's just about ready for bigger things, too. Now, all we gotta do is find a few more Deputy Captains, and Jean will be able to rest much easier.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: I only pray that the presence of these Deputy Captains decreases, rather than increases, her workload.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Oh, they'll do great! Don't you trust me, Seamus?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: *sigh* Anemo Archon willing...
